:COMMON JUDGMENT:
In M.V.C.No.448/2022, petitioner- Veerabhadraiah filed petition U/sec 166 of M.V. Act claiming compensation of Rs.10,50,000/- for the injuries sustained in the accident.
(Herein after called 1st petition).
In M.V.C.No.449/2022, petitioner- Hanumantharaju filed petition U/sec 166 of M.V. Act claiming compensation of Rs.10,50,000/- for the injuries sustained in the accident.
(Herein after called 2nd petition).
These petitions were clubbed at the request of parties.
The averments of both the petitions in brief is as follows:

On 13.01.2022 at about 4.00 p.m. the petitioner in M.V.C.448/2022 namely Veerabhadraiah was riding the Honda Passion Pro motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-02-JZ- 4467 along with the petitioner in M.V.C.449/2022 namely Hanumantharaju as a pillion rider.

When they were proceeding on SH-03, Dabaspet- Koratagere Road,
Dabaspet Town, Sompura Hobli, Nelamangalal Taluk Bangalore Rural District, at that time one KSRTC Bus bearing Reg.No.KA-42-F-2229 came with high speed, in a rash or negligent manner, without observing the traffic Hanumantharaju vs K.S.R.T.C on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118228861/
2 rules and dashed against the petitioner's vehicle and caused the accident.
Due to the said impact, both the petitioners were fell down along with the vehicle and sustained grievous injuries.

In M.V.C.448/2022, the petitioner namely Veerabhadraiah has sustained fracture of 3rd , 4th and 5th  SCCH-2 4 M.V.C.No.448/2022  C/W M.V.C.No.449/2022 Proximal Phalynex, Fracture of knee joint and other injuries to all over the body.
He was shifted to We Care Hospital,Dabaspet, wherein the petitioner was treated as an inpatient for 10 days.

The petitioner was discharged with an advise to take regular follow-up treatment and he has spend Rs.1,50,000/- towards medical expenses,
conveyance and nourishment expenses.
In M.V.C.449/2022, the petitioner namely Hanumantharaju has sustained Comminuted Patella fracture with fracture proximal Tibia on right side and other injuries to all over the body.
The petitioner was shifted to WE Care Hospital, Dabaspet, wherein he took treatment as an inpatient.
The petitioner has spend Rs.1,50,000/- towards medical expenses, conveyance and nourishment expenses.
Prior to the accident, both the petitioners were hale and healthy and they were working as Coolie and earning a sum of Rs.25,000/- and Rs.20,000/- per month
